newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian industry to grow at 6 pct in 96/97-Caspian.
newsitem.headline: Indian industry to grow at 6 pct in 96/97-Caspian.

text.p: Indian industry would post a lower growth rate in 1996/97 (April-March) due to high real interest rates, infrastructure constraints, lower rural demand and a fall in business confidence, Caspian Research India said in a report on Wednesday.
"We expect a sharp decline in industrial growth from 11.6 percent in financial 1996 (April-March) to 6.0 percent in financial 1997," the report said.
"Preliminary data reveals that the rate has fallen to 8.6 percent in the first five months of financial 1997 compared to 12.6 percent in the same period of financial 1996."
Caspian said the slowdown had been most apparent in the mining and electricity sectors.

In the first five months of the current financial year, the mining sector showed a growth rate of 1.3 percent against 14.3 percent in the same period last year while the electricity sector recorded 2.5 percent against 11.8 percent, it said.
The manufacturing sector did slightly better showing a smaller decline to 10.8 percent against last year's 12.5 percent, the report said.
Caspian said the agricultural sector was expected to do better this year, leading to increased overall demand from the rural population.
"After sharp growth of 4.9 percent in financial 1995, the agricultural sector showed a decline of 1.2 percent in financial 1996."
"This had a significant impact on consumption from a rural population, representing 65 percent of the total (population), dependent on agriculture."
Caspian said it expected agricultural growth rate to rebound to around 2.6 percent in the current financial year because of a good and well spread monsoon.
"The resulting demand from this sector of the economy will play an important role in preventing overall industrial production from slipping even further," it said.

Constraints such as infrastructure bottlenecks, high real interest rates and uncertain political conditions would result in a weaker industrial growth performance during the second half of financial 1997, the report forecast.
Poor performance by the industrial sector was likely to extend through at least the first quarter of financial 1998, it added.
